claim.text: Formula Atlas's workbook adapter must treat table calculated-column and totals-row metadata as formula sources because worksheet cells hold the table data while a separate table part stores table definitions. Refusing dependencies into those formula-result cells avoids treating cached worksheet values as authoritative when table formula semantics are unsupported.
claim.subject_definition: Formula Atlas Run 21 table formula dependency boundary

source.excerpt: Microsoft documents that worksheet XML contains actual table data while the table definition is stored in a separate table part. A calculatedColumnFormula stores the formula used to calculate each cell in a table column. TableColumn also supports totalsRowFormula and totalsRowFunction metadata.
source.subject_definition: Microsoft SpreadsheetML table structure and formula metadata
source.scope: Public Microsoft Learn pages retrieved 2026-09-24: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office/open-xml/spreadsheet/working-with-tables ; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/documentformat.openxml.spreadsheet.calculatedcolumnformula?view=openxml-2.12.2 ; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/documentformat.openxml.spreadsheet.tablecolumn?view=openxml-2.20.0 . Assesses the documentation boundary only, not implementation correctness.
